concerns.location: spec.md:User Story 1 – Data Ingestion, Validation, and Harmonization
concerns.text: User Story 1 (US‑1) has functional requirements (FR‑001, FR‑008) but no explicitly linked success criteria; the specification provides no SC that measures successful completion of the ingestion/validation pipeline.

SC-001 references a “baseline mean‑only model” without defining how that baseline is constructed (e.g., data split, training procedure, metric calculation). This makes the success criterion ambiguous and therefore not directly measurable.

The validation of interaction effects (SC-002) relies on comparing a Full Model (tree‑based with engineered interactions) to a Null Model (linear additive). Because the two models differ not only by the presence of interaction features but also by model class and non‑linearity, the observed ΔR² cannot be attributed solely to interaction terms. This conflates interaction importance with overall model capacity, violating the requirement that the validation target be independent of other predictor characteristics.

SHAP interaction values are used as a cross‑check for the engineered interaction columns (FR‑004). Since SHAP values are computed from the same trained model that already contains those engineered interactions, using them to ‘validate’ that the interactions are real is circular: the attribution method cannot provide independent evidence of interaction importance beyond what the model already encodes.

responses.response: Added a new Success Criterion (SC-007) that directly measures successful completion of the data ingestion, validation, and harmonization pipeline for US-1.
responses.what_changed: Appended SC-007 after SC-006 and linked it to US-1.

responses.response: Clarified the construction of the baseline mean‑only model in SC-001, specifying data split, training procedure, and metric calculation.
responses.what_changed: Rewrote SC-001 text to define baseline model and evaluation method.

responses.response: Adjusted FR-002 and SC-002 so that the Null Model uses the same algorithm (Random Forest) but without engineered interaction features, ensuring ΔR² isolates interaction contributions.
responses.what_changed: Modified FR-002 description and updated SC-002 wording to reflect same‑model Null comparison.

responses.response: Reframed FR-004 to state SHAP values are for interpretation only and added a new FR-012 that performs an independent permutation‑importance test of interaction columns.
responses.what_changed: Edited FR-004 text and inserted FR-012 after FR-005; referenced US‑3 for the new requirement.
